description: Acholi (Leb Acoli) is a Luo language spoken by about one and a half million people in northern Uganda, around Gulu, Kitgum and Pader, and across the border in South Sudan.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Acholi courses (#130) with low confidence in Acholi; needs a native-speaker review.

why.title: The language of **Gulu, Kitgum and the north.**
why.text: Acholi is spoken across northern Uganda and is close to Lango, Alur and the Luo of Kenya, so it opens a whole family of Luo languages. Learn it for family, travel, work, and the songs, dances and stories of the north.

cards.title: For family
cards.text: Talk with grandparents and relatives in Gulu and Kitgum.

cards.title: For travellers
cards.text: Find your way from Gulu to Kitgum, Pader and the Nile at Karuma.

cards.title: For the curious
cards.text: Meet a Luo language with tones, long and short vowels and no noun classes.

landing.farewell: Apwoyo matek — thank you very much.
landing.audience: Complete beginners, families from Acholi land, volunteers and travellers heading to northern Uganda.
landing.first: Greetings, introductions and numbers, then family, food, the market, time, places, the home and health, unit by unit.

cast.emma: A visitor learning Acholi before her trip
